parts.name: tube body

physics.Basic_description: The main white cylindrical body of the lipstick tube with a smooth matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the internal mechanism and provides the primary structure for holding the lipstick.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical side surface firmly to stabilize the object during manipulation.
physics.reason: Standard injection-molded plastic container wall enclosing empty space for the mechanism.

parts.description: The main white cylindrical body of the lipstick tube with a smooth matte finish.
parts.function: Houses the internal mechanism and provides the primary structure for holding the lipstick.

parts.name: neck threads

physics.Basic_description: The threaded rim at the top opening of the tube base, appearing white.
physics.Functional_description: Engages with the cap threads to secure the lid when closed.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and functional for grasping; avoid contact to prevent damage to threads.
physics.reason: Threads are typically solid features molded as part of the rim structure.

parts.description: The threaded rim at the top opening of the tube base, appearing white.
parts.function: Engages with the cap threads to secure the lid when closed.

parts.name: center band

physics.Basic_description: A thin decorative ring or band near the top of the tube, appearing slightly distinct in the mask.
physics.Functional_description: Provides aesthetic detail or marks the separation between base and cap interface.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a primary grasp point; too narrow for stable gripping.
physics.reason: Integral part of the thin-walled tube shell.

parts.description: A thin decorative ring or band near the top of the tube, appearing slightly distinct in the mask.
parts.function: Provides aesthetic detail or marks the separation between base and cap interface.

annotationMapping.method: unique scaled centroid (source volume uses thinwall_solid_tetra)

parts.name: slider body

physics.Basic_description: A small red rectangular tab protruding from the side slot of the tube.
physics.Functional_description: Actuates the internal mechanism to raise or lower the lipstick bullet.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be pinched by fine gripper tips to slide up or down, but fragile.
physics.reason: Small functional component likely molded solid for strength.

parts.description: A small red rectangular tab protruding from the side slot of the tube.
parts.function: Actuates the internal mechanism to raise or lower the lipstick bullet.

parts.name: bullet red

physics.Basic_description: The red lipstick product itself, visible at the top opening with a slanted tip.
physics.Functional_description: The consumable cosmetic material applied to lips.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; soft and deformable, would be damaged by gripper pressure.

parts.description: The red lipstick product itself, visible at the top opening with a slanted tip.
parts.function: The consumable cosmetic material applied to lips.

parts.name: cap shell

physics.Basic_description: The white cylindrical cap that covers the top of the tube, smooth matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the lipstick bullet and seals the tube when not in use.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the side of the cap to pull it off or place it back on the tube.
physics.reason: Hollow shell designed to fit over the tube base.

parts.description: The white cylindrical cap that covers the top of the tube, smooth matte finish.
parts.function: Protects the lipstick bullet and seals the tube when not in use.

parts.name: cap threads

physics.Basic_description: Internal threading inside the bottom rim of the cap.
physics.Functional_description: Screws onto the tube base neck to secure the cap.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal feature, not accessible for external grasping.
physics.reason: Threaded ridge is a solid feature of the cap wall.

parts.description: Internal threading inside the bottom rim of the cap.
parts.function: Screws onto the tube base neck to secure the cap.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
